title: 6 Minute Core
texts: An easy to follow 6 minute core workout

Complete all sets and reps for each exercise in order, always working for 30 seconds and subsequently resting for 30 seconds. If these exercises cause back pain, stop immediately and do not complete these exercises!

Add ankle and/or wrist weights to increase the intensity for Dish Tucks, Dish Variations, Marching Planks and Superman. Use a dumbbell or kettlebell for weighted twists. 

1. Dish tuck (vary arm position for intensity or add wrist/ankle weights)

2. Weighted twists (extend the full range of movement on each side for increased difficulty)

3. Weighted sit ups (change weight or arm position into more of an overhead position)

4. Marching plank (keep the level of the hips even, don't let your lower back arch and only add ankle weights once form is excellent throughout)

5. Dish paddles (alter body angle for intensity or add ankle/wrist weights)

6. Superman (most climbers will prefer elbows to the side and the intensity can be altered by adding wrist/ankle weights)
